text:
marta.g: Kicking off preflight for ap-southeast-2 cluster bring-up. Running a focused load+soak tonight 22:00-10:00 UTC. Objective: validate autoscaler behavior under ramp+plateau, cross-AZ networking, and KV cache warmup. Min nodes 4 / target_util 65% / max nodes 80. Will need oncall handoff at end.

jin.k: On it. I pushed the soak orchestration job to staging. Test plan attached as gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123 (contains ramp script + traffic profile).

samir: Two quick asks: 1) ensure GPU driver/cuda versions match image (we had a mismatch last time) 2) have a cheap fallback policy (fp16 quantized variant) if cost spikes.

marta.g: Good call. jin, can you validate node image ids against the fleet manifest? sample check:```sh
curl -s https://fleet.internal/meta | jq '.images["ap-southeast-2"].gpu'
# expect: rdx-gpu-v2-cuda12
```

jin.k: Ran that; staging shows rdx-gpu-v2-cuda12 on 3 AZs. prod will be identical. Also baked a small init-job to pre-populate KV cache on new nodes to avoid high token costs on cold starts.

leah.p: Observability notes: make sure the autoscaler has these metrics exported: node_utilization_pct, pending_pods, pod_eviction_count, kv_cache_misses. I added alerts: node_utilization > 90% for 5m, or scale up flapping detection.

obs-bot: [metric-stream] Created dashboard: "ap-southeast-2 soak — autoscale & networking". Link: https://obs.redwood/inbox/d/soak-asg-18421

deploy-bot: Deployment started: soak-worker-2026-03-18 @ 1842109920. Image: soak-runner:2026-03-18-rc5. Rolling to AZs with 10s stagger.

marta.g: Load profile: 0-30m ramp to 60% util, 30-180m step to 85% to validate scale out, then 8h plateau at ~70% with occasional 2m spikes to 95% to exercise eviction and fallback. We'll intentionally throttle cache to measure cost differences.

samir: Tune suggestion during step phase: reduce cooldown to 30s and keep stabilization window 2m to allow aggressive scale-up but avoid oscillation on short spikes. Also set scaleDownDelay=7m to avoid churn.

jin.k: I will apply a canary autoscale config in the cluster:```yaml
policy: 
  target_util_pct: 65
  min_nodes: 4
  max_nodes: 80
  scale_up: { cooldown: 30s, stabilization: 2m }
  scale_down: { delay: 7m }
```
Pushing at 21:45 UTC.

leah.p: Observability checklist before start: synthetic trace across AZs, p99 tail latency alerting, NVidia MIG errors, and network egress b/w AZs. I added a temporary log sampling rule to keep token costs low.

oncall-tom: I'll be primary for the night. Handoff procedure: if we see sustained failed scheduling >5m or node boot failures >2 nodes in 15m, escalate to eng-infra. I'll keep a runbook tab open.

marta.g: Cost guardrails: cap burst autoscale to 40 nodes until 23:30 UTC, after which we can open to 80 if behavior is stable. If projected spend delta > 30% vs baseline, auto-rollback to quantized model variants.

obs-bot: [event] KV cache warmup completed at 1842110100 for soak-runner group. Cache miss rate dropped from 78% -> 12% after pre-population.

jin.k: First ramp completed, autoscaler scaled from 4 -> 18 nodes in 6m. No node bootstrap errors. Latency p95 rose to 420ms during spike but recovered.

samir: Noted a cross-AZ packet loss blip in AZ-b at 1842110305 (~30s). Network team was paged, appears to be a transient fabric flap. Good to verify retry/backoff is ok.

oncall-tom: We're watching. If the fabric does another flap, we'll shift traffic away from AZ-b and tag nodes Unhealthy for scheduler until network stabilizes.

marta.g: After 2h of plateau we'll run a cost regression and capture a small eval set for quality checks. Handoff to platform (leah/samir) at 07:00 UTC with post-soak notes: include autoscaler events, node boot histogram, network incidents, and cost delta.

leah.p: I added a minimal postmortem template in the runbook. Please annotate any manual mitigations in thread so we can index later. :thumbsup:

marta.g: Thanks team — starting the run. Ping in thread for any urgent changes.

deploy-bot: soak-runner-2026-03-18 rollout succeeded @ 1842110400.

obs-bot: [alert] p95 latency > 500ms for 3m at 1842110430 — currently auto-scaling to recover.

jin.k: scaling to compensate, will monitor. If it doesn't resolve in 6m we'll switch to fallback model and notify.

marta.g: Copy. Documenting fallback trigger: p95 > 600ms for 8m OR cost > +40% forecast => switch to quantized model and cap max nodes at 40.

oncall-tom: Handoff reminder: final summary in thread by 07:00 UTC. I'll stay until 08:00 for overlap.

marta.g: End of preflight thread. Keep replies short — we'll aggregate for the post-soak writeup.
